records.title: Kyushu University Friendship Scholarship
records.deadline_display: There are two recruitment periods in a fiscal year. Period I: Scholarship recipients who will begin their studies at Kyushu University between April and September will be recruited around February through their host departments at Kyushu University. Term II: Scholarship recipients who will begin their studies at Kyushu University between October and March will be recruited around May through their host departments at Kyushu University.

source.publisher: International Student Center (Global Gateways), Kyushu University
source.raw_extract: Application Period | There are two recruitment periods in a fiscal year. | Period I: Scholarship recipients who will begin their studies at Kyushu University between April and September will be recruited around February through their host departments at Kyushu University. | Term II: Scholarship recipients who will begin their studies at Kyushu University between October and March will be recruited around May through their host departments at Kyushu University.
source.exact_deadline_wording: There are two recruitment periods in a fiscal year.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url (https://www.kyushu-u.ac.jp/en/admissions/financial-support/scholarships/international) returned HTTP 404. The live official International Student Center page was fetched instead; it is also the shard's catalogue_url, and the university's own Financial Aid page (https://www.kyushu-u.ac.jp/en/admission/fees/support) links to this exact section for the Kyushu University Friendship Scholarship, confirming identity. Kyushu publishes no fixed date: recruitment happens 'around February' and 'around May', and the application is made through the applicant's prospective host department, which sets its own internal date within the period. Recurring annual timing only, so no calendar date was written.

source.notes: Posse publishes no fixed date at all: it states deadlines vary by Posse city or programme and that applicants must contact their local Posse office for the specific dates at the start of every calendar year. The award is nomination-based rather than self-applied ('Are you part of a high school or a community-based organization... If you're registered with Posse, you can nominate high school students as early as their second semester junior year'). Recurring annual timing with no current calendar date, so no date was written. The record's existing verification_status of needs_review is consistent with this.
